==Background==
{{Quote|Hello、Chouchou-P here.

I tried to make a cool song.
I tried my best with the English lyrics, so please forgive me if it has anything wrong.

「On a rainy day、goodbye.」|Chouchou-P}}
This is Chouchou-P's first song with [[Megpoid English|GUMI English]]. The song was commissioned for the [[EXIT TUNES]] compilation album ''[[EXIT TUNES PRESENTS Vocalofanatic feat. GUMI、IA、MAYU|Vocalofanatic]]''. The song focuses on a boy who seems to remember a love from his past, with the person who could have been the love of his life and because of his own doubts and insecurities, the relationship ended up failing and he ends up feeling guilty.

This song has reached the ''[[Hall of Legend]]'', and is the second English VOCALOID song to do so.

==Lyrics==
<poem style="margin-left:1em;">
I have a story to tell
Do you hear me tonight
It's things about me
I'll be waiting in bedroom
But anyway you can't come
I get it,never mind

Now, it is starting to rain
I feel you drop tears
And my heart become heavy
What's this world coming to?
There's nothing that can be done
I couldn't careless

It's wonderful for me that world is moving now
Some lights turn around and around
I lost my head again
And just want to throw everything away
It's not that easy

Maybe I'm afraid I'm not as tender guy as you think
Looking your eyes, and I say "love you" with fake smile
I don't know what to do
Please tell me what should I do
Just feel so sad inside, but I kiss you
Kiss you...

I have a story to tell
Do you hear me tonight
It's things about me
I'll be waiting in bedroom
But anyway you can't come
I get it, never mind

I can't get my mind off you
I'm such an idiot
Same as usual
You made me feel so better
It brings back memories
It's things about you

My hands can't take back that the time I passed with you
Some doubts broke me down, broke me down
If you are still alive, I wanted to say it's not your fault
But it's too late for us

Maybe I'm afraid I'm not as tender guy as you think
Looking your eyes, and I say "love you" with fake smile
I don't know what to do
Please tell me what should I do
Just feel so sad inside, but I kiss you
Kiss you...

It's wonderful for me that world is moving now
Some lights turn around and around
I lost my head again
And just want to throw everything away
It's not that easy
</poem>

<br>

<poem style="margin-left:1em;">
Maybe I'm afraid I'm not as tender guy as you think
I close my eyes, and I say "love you" with true smile
I don't know what to do
Please tell me what should I do
Just feel so sad inside, but say good-bye
Good-bye...
</poem>

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song was featured on the following albums:
* ''[[EXIT TUNES PRESENTS Vocalofanatic feat. GUMI、IA、MAYU|Vocalofanatic]]''
* ''[[End of the World (album)|End of the World]]''
* ''[[EXIT TUNES PRESENTS GUMissimo from Megpoid ―10th ANNIVERSARY BEST―|GUMissimo]]''

===Video games===
This song was featured in the following video games:
*SOUND VOLTEX II -infinite infection-
*SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS
*{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}} (Virtual Singer version by GUMI; SEKAI version by Vivid BAD SQUAD and Hatsune Miku)
